blocks.text: *Al-Majīd* is the One noble in his essence, beautiful in his deeds and liberal in his gift and favour. Even as nobility of essence when joined to goodness in deeds is "glory" so that He is called **al-Mājid** as well as (**al-Majīd**), yet one of the two (i.e., the latter) is more indicative of magnification. Al-Majid appears to combine the meaning of the names **al-Jalīl,** **al-Wahhāb** and al-Karim, and we have spoken about them previously.
